cf249f76.text: Battle of Okpo (May 1592) — 24 Joseon Panokseon approach 50 anchored transports in Okpo Bay. Ride the flood current (~ Wave) into the harbor. 1/4: Sweep a WAVE (~) to ride the northbound flood current into Okpo Bay.

285e35c3.text: Battle of Hansando — Crane Wing (Aug 1592) — 56 Joseon warships (3 Geobukseon) face 73 warships off Hansando. Feign retreat (~ Wave) into open water. 1/4: Sweep a WAVE (~) to lure the enemy vanguard out of Gyeonnaeryang Channel.

3c54a498.text: Battle of Myeongnyang — 13 vs 133 (Oct 1597) — 13 Joseon Panokseon face 133 warships in the narrow Uldolmok Gorge. Drop iron anchors (/ Slash) in the channel. 1/4: Draw a SLASH (/) to drop heavy anchors across the narrow Uldolmok choke point.

eb76f2a6.text: Battle of Noryang — Dawn Drumbeat (Dec 1598) — 63 Joseon warships seal Noryang Strait at midnight against 500 retreating vessels. 1/4: Draw a CIRCLE (O) to form a silent pre-dawn blockade across Noryang Strait.

d3f053d7.text: All 24 Panokseon glide silently into the harbor mouth. Next: 2/4: Draw a SLASH (/) to form a line abreast blocking the seaward escape.

2ccd3d38.text: The Joseon line seals the bay; enemy transports are trapped against the shore. Next: 3/4: Draw a CIRCLE (O) to curve both wings into the cove around the anchored fleet.

504c70c6.text: Both wings close in around the cove. Next: 4/4: Draw a CROSS (+) to loose flaming fire arrows (bijeok) into the anchored sails.

d34c40b8.text: Victory at Okpo! 26 transports burn in the harbor with zero Joseon ships lost. (Battle of Okpo (May 1592) Complete — 4/4 Maneuvers).

8e171e0a.text: The pursuit fleet takes the bait and enters the wide waters off Hansando. Next: 2/4: Draw a CIRCLE (O) to wheel all 56 ships into the Crane Wing (Hakikjin) crescent.

ee3fa694.text: Left and right wings sweep outward in a giant U-encirclement. Next: 3/4: Draw a SLASH (/) to drive the 3 iron-roofed Turtle Ships into the enemy center.

7b7b19b2.text: The dragon-prow Turtle Ships shatter the central command formation. Next: 4/4: Draw a CROSS (+) to close the Crane Wing pincers and fire converging broadsides.

d9b92c20.text: Decisive victory at Hansando! 47 of 73 enemy ships destroyed; sea lanes secured. (Battle of Hansando — Crane Wing (Aug 1592) Complete — 4/4 Maneuvers).

5b4a1d54.text: Admiral Yi's flagship holds the narrow gorge while 133 ships bottleneck behind it. Next: 2/4: Draw a CIRCLE (O) to rally all 12 remaining warships beside the flagship.

8c59be75.text: Inspired by the flagship's stand, all 13 vessels form an unbreakable defensive arc. Next: 3/4: Sweep a WAVE (~) as the violent Uldolmok current reverses southward against the enemy.

5d7875d8.text: The roaring current reverses! Tangled enemy ships collide in the narrow gorge. Next: 4/4: Draw a CROSS (+) to ride the surging current down on the retreating vanguard.

76fc82a8.text: Miracle at Myeongnyang! 31 enemy warships sunk; all 13 Joseon ships survive. (Battle of Myeongnyang — 13 vs 133 (Oct 1597) Complete — 4/4 Maneuvers).

504b7477.text: 63 Joseon ships seal the strait under midnight mist. Next: 2/4: Sweep a WAVE (~) to advance silently through the fog.

875ce318.text: Allied ships emerge from the mist at close quarters. Next: 3/4: Draw a SLASH (/) to cleave the retreating column with the 4 Turtle Ships.

fe6c5d0a.text: The retreating formation is split in two across the strait. Next: 4/4: Draw a CROSS (+) to beat the war drum at sunrise until the final ship retreats.

a6aa37f9.text: Dawn breaks over Noryang Strait; Admiral Yi's drum beats steadily until peace is won. (Battle of Noryang — Dawn Drumbeat (Dec 1598) Complete — 4/4 Maneuvers).
